about: What is on the CMU robot today, on top of the assembly guide's whole-robot data (make_visual.py). Source: Shawn, 2026-10-20: torso shells and thighs are white, the back carries the two-converter box (bench supply), its rear lid on since 2026-10-26 (Shawn; the layout-F cap, the V1.20 print by inference since the printed V1.17 cap's screw floors tore), the ankles are the V1.24/V1.25 two-half ankle on the V1.22 sleeves with the V1.22 slip-fit feet (CURRENT-STATE.json ankle_bracket, 2026-10-23). The head shells are the 2026-10-20 A7Z head; since 2026-10-26 the A7Z is out of the head on the D-022 roof saddle (body only: the saddle lid, the board screws and the 6530B are not recorded as fitted), the walking robot of FOUNDATION-20261023.md. Colours are the printed filament colours of colour scheme C (guide/print/colour-study-20261014/make_specs.py); the guide's own colours are display colours.

body_override_reasons.amplifier: sits in the head beside the speaker; nearest official mesh is the head-yaw link 4 mm closer than the head
body_override_reasons.idler12: motor 12 rides on the neck body, so its rear idler horn turns with the torso side like its output horn
body_override_reasons.saddle_body: the roof saddle and the A7Z on it sit on the torso roof; the neck and head meshes are 25 mm and more away at HOME, the torso is the body they ride on

part_files_reason: The robot wears the V1.24/V1.25 two-half ankle (stock bracket cut at mid shaft: outer half on the horn, inner half on the V1.22 black sleeve, screwed together at the toe since 2026-10-23; microduck-sim/CURRENT-STATE.json ankle_bracket) with the V1.22 slip-fit feet: the guide/gate world files of guide/print/ankle-halves-20261020 and release-V1.22 (guide frame, mm). The guide's ankle and ankle_cheek keys draw these halves, but the files are named here so the model does not follow a later guide revision. The head shells are the 2026-10-20 A7Z head on the walking robot (V1.17 cap and face, V1.8 lower shell, original jaw support), while the guide has moved on to the extension head (U20 face, exit lower shell and jaw support, ear cap); each file matched the 2026-10-20 head meshes within their reduction error (99th percentile 0.3-1 mm) on 2026-10-24. The roof saddle on the robot (since 2026-10-26) is the D-022-layout body printed on the V1.33 White plate (sha 38689e46, kept as a7z-saddle/build/retired-v129/saddle_body-v129.stl) while the guide carries the V3 saddle of D-028.

jaw.open_positive: a positive angle about axis swings the lip tip down (opens)
jaw.source: guide/extension-20261012-neck-audio/neck-route/nr_lib.py JAW_PIVOT / JAW_AXIS (robot frame, mm), the hinge the jaw pose-cap study sweeps

battery.about: The 2S battery backpack (D-010, apply_masses variant battery): the bench converter box comes off, the backpack goes on.

extra_parts_reason: On the robot but no longer a part of the guide data (guide-20261022-saddle). The A7Z on the roof saddle (saddle_a7z_*, since 2026-10-26): the guide's V3 board parts mapped onto the D-022 saddle pose by saddle_d022.py, because the guide no longer carries the D-022 saddle that is on the robot.
not_fitted_reason: Battery backpack: the battery variant only. Extensions that are designed or printed but not on the walking robot (FOUNDATION-20261023.md, D-022 to D-025): the saddle lid (its fit is not recorded) and the V3 saddle board parts sd_* (drawn in the D-022 pose as saddle_a7z_*), the ear microphones, the mouth speaker box, the U20CAM USB camera with its head exit clamp. Head wire clips: never fitted.

frozen.about: Parts inside the head on the walking robot that the guide data no longer carries: the speaker with its tape loop, the speaker retainer and the amplifier. The guide moved to the D-022/D-023/D-025 extension head (guide-20261022-saddle) and its generated data of the A7Z head is not kept, so these are the meshes make_visual.py wrote on 2026-10-20 from guide-20261015-backpack, kept as files (the two head wire clips, never fitted, were taken out of jaw_soft__orange). They sit inside the closed head. The head shells come from part_files; the head servos and the jaw from the guide. On 2026-10-26 the A7Z left the head for the roof saddle (Shawn) and the U20CAM replaced the Radxa CSI camera (CURRENT-STATE.json parts_a7z_extensions), so the A7Z with its header, pins, jumper ends, sockets and microSD card, the AC019 antenna with its coax and IPEX plug, and the Radxa camera board with its ribbon were cut out of these meshes: every one of their pieces lies at z <= -46 mm in the jaw_soft frame, every kept piece (speaker, tape, retainer, amplifier) at z >= -33 mm, and the cut kept the connected components above z -40 mm. The board is drawn on the saddle by saddle_d022.py.
